monetization.reason: No approved affiliate program or tracking ID is configured. The active conversion improvement is the product-neutral soil/coco/hydro system comparison: it connects purchase intent to the actual media identity, water source, monitoring burden, drainage, sanitation, replacement parts, waste, return terms, first-cycle cost, and failure recovery. No merchant, model, live price, discount, ranking, availability claim, fabricated test, or product image was added; a simpler system or no-grow outcome remains valid.

image_qa.note: All three pages use original text, tables, checklists, decision cards, existing interface assets, and verified source links. No edible, package, grow medium, hydroponic system, product, affiliate, generated, stock, or third-party image was added or changed, so no exact-product mismatch or new licensing ambiguity was introduced.

search_console.decision: The October 19–November 15 report is six days old and valid: 830 impressions, three clicks, 0.361% CTR, and average position 20.688. Blue Dream (36 and 12 query impressions) and Arkansas (10 page impressions, one click, position 10.2) were already materially reinforced on November 17 and November 12. The two-impression 510-versus-disposable query already maps to an exact comparison page; two-impression trimming-scissors and Delaware rows and the one-impression chronic-pain HTTP row are too small or already addressed. No item in this batch is primarily Data-led: those weak or duplicative signals were deliberately ignored rather than used to manufacture another variation. The batch instead adds distinct edible-claim, cultivation-system, and site-tool intents.

authority.action: Published a citation-ready fast-acting-edible claim translator and evidence ladder using Health Canada, CDC, and New York OCM sources; published a decision-first soil/coco/hydro system comparison using New York OCM and university extension sources; and created a decision-based tools hub that consolidates established calculators, recall checks, evidence worksheets, response logs, and buying plans without cloning their intent. Reciprocal links strengthen the edibles, label-math, evidence-literacy, lawful home-grow, water-monitoring, and tool-navigation clusters. No outreach opportunity was logged and no outreach was sent; the on-site authority assets and crawl paths were the higher-value action.
